title: BIM Consultancy Services for Architectural, Structural, and MEP services for CPWD projects
scope_summary: The tender is for comprehensive BIM consultancy services for architectural, structural, and MEP services, including BIM modeling of minimum LOD 350, clash detection, and preparation of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) for various buildings. The BIM model will be used for design, coordination, and integration of plumbing, sanitary, electrical, firefighting, fire alarm, HVAC, and low voltage systems, as well as horticulture and landscaping design.

title: Supply of Terrestrial Laser Scanner
tendering_authority: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
scope_summary: This tender invites sealed quotations for the supply of a Terrestrial Laser Scanner with specific technical requirements including the ability to generate contours from point cloud data, cross-section generation, volume computation, and noise removal. The software should also be capable of controlling the scanner and performing global registration.

title: Tender for Non-Contact 3D Optical Profilometer for Optics Surface Form/Shape Measurement
scope_summary: This is a two-part e-tender for the supply of a non-contact 3D optical profilometer. Key technical requirements include the ability to export 3D point cloud data in various formats and provision for data analysis. Bidders are advised not to mention prices in the technical bid.

title: AI BASED SNAG RECTIFICATION AND PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE BASED ON GROUND AND FLIGHT DATA SYSTEM - EOI
scope_summary: Expression of Interest (EOI) for an AI-based system for snag rectification and predictive maintenance using ground and flight data.
